scope: Great Ape and boss-exclusive skill taxonomy corrections

corrections.name: Energy Cannon
corrections.effect: Creates turrets that fire a volley of small Ki Blasts followed by three larger Ki Blasts.
corrections.reason: Dedicated Xenoverse skill documentation explicitly categorizes Energy Cannon as Super and Ki Blast and identifies Final Form Demigra as its user.

notes: Boulder Toss and Boulder Break remain at the provisional Other subtype from Batch 283 because the newly retrieved Great Ape Festival evidence confirms they are Supers and identifies their users, but does not explicitly expose the game's Strike/Ki Blast subtype. Energy Cannon receives a provenance correction based on dedicated Xenoverse skill documentation. Acid remains Other because reliable retrieved XV2 evidence still does not expose an attack-type field; Saibabeam is retained as Ki Blast based on its explicit energy-wave description.
